001: I'm so hungry! Do you know a good restaurant around here?
I do. There's a great Italian place two blocks from here.
Really? And is the price fair?
It's a little expensive, but the food is worth every penny.
Then let's go. I'm dying to eat some pasta.
Perfect! Let's go before it gets crowded.
002: Where do you usually have lunch near work?
I usually go to a self-service place that has very fresh salad.
That's nice! And is the atmosphere calm?
It's pretty busy at lunchtime, but the service is fast.
I prefer quieter places, but that's okay.
If you want, we can try another place tomorrow.
003: Have you tried that new restaurant on the corner?
Not yet, but I heard the all-you-can-eat is excellent.
I heard that too. Do you want to go with me on Saturday?
I'd love to! What time should we meet?
How about noon? That way we avoid the line.
Deal. I'll get there a little early to make sure we get a table.
004: I need a restaurant tip to celebrate my birthday.
How nice! Do you prefer Japanese or Brazilian food?
I prefer something more sophisticated, with special dishes.
Then I recommend a contemporary cuisine place near the park.
I've heard great things about it. Do they take reservations?
They do. Do you want me to call and book a table?
005: This restaurant is really crowded today, isn't it?
It sure is. I think there's an event at the company next door.
That makes sense. Can you handle waiting a bit?
I can, but only if we order an appetizer while we wait.
Good idea! Let's order the portion of fries.
Great, and then we'll decide on the main dish.
006: What's the best Bahian food restaurant you know?
I know an authentic one downtown, with delicious acarajé.
That's great! And is the atmosphere family-friendly?
It's quite simple, but the seasoning is wonderful.
I don't care about the decor, I just want to eat well.
Then you'll love it. Shall we go this weekend?
007: Do you know if that seafood restaurant is good?
I do. I went there last month and the moqueca was incredible.
Good to know! And is the price affordable?
It's a bit above average, but the portion size makes up for it.
Then it's worth it for a special occasion.
Definitely. They also have a beautiful view of the sea.
008: I'm tired of always eating at the same places.
Me too. How about we explore a new area today?
Good idea! Do you know a neighborhood with good options?
I know one with several really unique food fairs.
I love that kind of thing. Can we walk there?
We can, it's only twenty minutes from here.
009: How do you choose a restaurant when you travel?
I always read reviews online and ask the locals.
Good strategy. And have you ever had a bad surprise?
I have. Once I went to a famous place and the dish came cold.
That's a shame! That ruins the experience.
That's why nowadays I prefer smaller, more homey places.
010: Do you know a romantic restaurant for a special date?
I know one with dim lighting and live music, very charming.
Sounds perfect. And is the food good?
It's excellent, especially the mushroom risotto.
I'll make the reservation today. Thanks for the tip!
You're welcome! Let me know later if you guys liked it.
